$comment: THE LIST OF THINGS YOUR CHILD MAY OPEN.
What ships here are the apps that come inside Sukhi Play. They are files on
your own disk: no network, no adverts, nobody's terms to agree to, and
nothing that can change under you. That makes them the only things this
project is willing to switch on for you, so a first run has something on it
and works on a train.
Websites are a different matter. Sukhi Play does not choose destinations for
you and does not endorse any site: you add the ones you want, and you are
responsible for complying with each site's terms. The grown-up screen has a
catalogue of ones known to work, or paste any address you like. Please read
DISCLAIMER.md.
TO ADD A SITE BY HAND: copy an entry below, give it an https:// url, list
the hosts it needs in allowHosts, and set "enabled": true.
TO CHECK IT WORKS:     npm run check -- --check=<id>
FIELDS
id           unique short name, no spaces
title        caption under the tile
url          the page that opens. https://, or sukhiplay:// for a
bundled app (see config/bundled.json)
shape        one of the sixteen in src/main/catalog.js
color        tile colour, #rrggbb
allowHosts   ONLY these hosts may load anything. Everything else is cut.
'example.com' also covers 'a.example.com', never 'evil-example.com'.
denyHosts    overrides allowHosts, for ad subdomains of an allowed domain
enabled      true to show the tile
